bundles.note: The cost of a bundle is the sum of the purchase costs of its components. A gift in the composition counts as cost.

export.body: Each row: date, customer, gift, net purchase cost, document. The customer is the same buyer in all orders, even when Allegro gives a different e-mail each time. The yearly thresholds (20 zł and 100 zł) are judged by your accountant, OpenLinker does not watch them.

movements.body: Stock movements with the reason Gift for this period are in the stock history. Bundle components leave stock as ordinary sales and are not listed separately.
